svg.title: \begin{gathered} \mathrm{Pr}(Y = k \mid X = x) = \dfrac{e^{\beta_{k0}+\beta_{k1}x_1+\cdots+\beta_{kp}x_p}}{1 + \sum_{l=1}^{K-1} e^{\beta_{l0}+\beta_{l1}x_1+\cdots+\beta_{lp}x_p}} \\[2em] \mathrm{Pr}(Y = K \mid X = x) = \dfrac{1}{1 + \sum_{l=1}^{K-1} e^{\beta_{l0}+\beta_{l1}x_1+\cdots+\beta_{lp}x_p}}\,. \\[2em] \log\left( \dfrac{\mathrm{Pr}(Y = k \mid X = x)}{\mathrm{Pr}(Y = K \mid X = x)} \right) = \beta_{k0} + \beta_{k1}x_1 + \cdots + \beta_{kp}x_p. \end{gathered}
